brief: Verify credit claims and respond to an unfamiliar account without treating a score or advertisement as authority.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Protect the credit record"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Protege el historial"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Proteja o histórico"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Verify credit claims and respond to an unfamiliar account without treating a score or advertisement as authority.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Protect your records while checking what a credit offer actually establishes.
instruction.misconception: Urgency, a score threshold or a deletion promise establishes the authority of an unsolicited contact.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: A deletion promise does not establish legitimate authority.

help: Verify the process independently before sharing records or paying.

options.label: Preserve details and use verified reporting channels
Delete the report to stop the account
